dialogue.en: Hi, can I take tomorrow off? I have a doctor's appointment.
dialogue.speaker: Employee
dialogue.zh: 你好，我明天能请假吗？我约了看医生。

dialogue.en: Sure. Did you put it in the system?
dialogue.speaker: Supervisor
dialogue.zh: 可以。你在系统里申请了吗？

dialogue.en: Not yet. I'll do it right now.
dialogue.speaker: Employee

dialogue.en: Okay. Make sure someone covers your shift.
dialogue.speaker: Supervisor
dialogue.zh: 好的。确保有人替你的班。

dialogue.en: I already asked Lisa, she said yes. Thank you!
dialogue.speaker: Employee
dialogue.zh: 我已经问过 Lisa 了，她答应了。谢谢！

featuredPhrase.en: I need to take the day off tomorrow.

phrases.en: I need to take the day off tomorrow.

phrases.zh: 我今天请病假。（打电话时说）

phrases.zh: 请假需要提前多久申请？

phrases.en: My supervisor approved my time off.
phrases.zh: 我的主管批准了我的假。
